summary: Frontend-only testing of (1) smooth-scroll Enroll Now buttons and (2) new TRADE50 (50% off) coupon alongside RENEW (90% off). All 12 scenarios from the review request passed on the live preview URL.

test_results.invalid_coupon_FAKE123: PASS — final price reverts to ₹6,999, no coupon-badge
test_results.course_switch_recomputes: PASS — switching to Stock course with TRADE50 active → ₹2,000
test_results.regression_payment_section: PASS — QR, UPI copy, course selector, final-price all intact

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: cta-enroll-btn still uses an <a href='#enroll'> with preventDefault — works, but could be a <button> for consistency with hero-enroll-btn (not blocking).
Minor: In applyCoupon(), success/error toast fires on apply button, but clicking a hint-chip also fires toast — behavior is consistent; no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (smooth-scroll Enroll buttons + dual coupons RENEW/TRADE50) are fully functional end-to-end. UPI deep link and WhatsApp link both correctly embed active coupon code. Case-insensitive matching verified.
